decision.reason: The exact reviewed endpoint follows from Mathlib’s isBilimitOfTotal, bicone construction and IsBilimit.total; independent source and audit in NotesProofs/ReviewedFiniteBiproductConnection.lean and evidence/reviewed-finite-biproduct-build.log.
decision.proof:
by
  classical
  intro C _ _ J _ X
  letI : Fintype J := Fintype.ofFinite J
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro B h
    exact ⟨CategoryTheory.Limits.isBilimitOfTotal B h⟩
  · intro P hP
    exact CategoryTheory.Limits.IsBilimit.total (CategoryTheory.Limits.biconeIsBilimitOfLimitConeOfIsLimit hP)
  · intro Q hQ
    exact CategoryTheory.Limits.IsBilimit.total (CategoryTheory.Limits.biconeIsBilimitOfColimitCoconeOfIsColimit hQ)
